stageLabels: 🌱 Starter · create the need to know
👩‍🏫 I Do 2 · connect the second idea

sequence.title: Sugar Evidence: Read the Label
sequence.outcome: Sugar investigation and Autumn 1 consolidation: skeletons, muscles and nutrition.
sequence.objective: I can compare sugar values using the same label basis and order four supplied food labels from least to most sugar.

sequence.title: Body Science Checkpoint
sequence.outcome: Sugar investigation and Autumn 1 consolidation: skeletons, muscles and nutrition.
sequence.objective: I can use models and evidence to show what I know about skeletons, muscle pairs, nutrition, balance and food sources.

sequence.title: Rock Evidence Lab: Look Before You Label
sequence.outcome: Compare and group rocks by their appearance and simple properties.
sequence.objective: I can compare rock specimens using observed properties and create a group using a stated rule.

sequence.title: Build a Rock Sorting Key
sequence.outcome: Compare and group rocks by their appearance and simple properties.
sequence.objective: I can apply a clear rock-grouping rule, check a mystery specimen and defend the placement with evidence.

sequence.title: Rock Hardness: Mark or Groove?
sequence.objective: I can explain relative hardness and identify a fair, safe scratch method for comparing rock samples.

sequence.title: Hardness Evidence Lab
sequence.objective: I can use the same stated scratch method to compare four coded rock samples and give a cautious evidence-based conclusion.

sequence.title: Permeability: Surface or Through?
sequence.outcome: Test rocks for whether they let water through (permeability).
sequence.objective: I can distinguish water on a surface, water soaking in and water passing through a supplied rock sample.

sequence.title: Water Through Rock Lab
sequence.outcome: Test rocks for whether they let water through (permeability).
sequence.objective: I can follow or direct a fixed water-passage method, record what reaches the collector and make a careful comparison of supplied samples.

sequence.title: Rock Jobs: Which Property Matters?
sequence.outcome: Identify everyday uses of different rocks (links D&T / Construction).
sequence.objective: I can identify which tested or observed rock property matters for a stated everyday job.

sequence.title: Choose Rock for the Job
sequence.outcome: Identify everyday uses of different rocks (links D&T / Construction).
sequence.objective: I can choose a supplied rock sample for a stated model job and justify the decision with relevant property evidence and a limit.

sequence.title: Fair Test Planner: Change One Thing
sequence.outcome: Plan a simple fair test on rocks; pilot the method ready for the full investigation.
sequence.objective: I can plan a safe fair comparison by naming one changed variable, one measured result, the controls and the repeats.

sequence.title: Method Pilot: Test the Test
sequence.outcome: Pilot and revise a simple fair-test method ready for the full rock investigation.
sequence.objective: I can carry out or direct a small method pilot, identify a procedural problem and revise the plan ready for W14.
